Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing impairment documented in 7/7 patients.
Astrocytic tumor originating in the central nervous system.
Osteosclerosis and craniosynostosis define skeletal disease; developmental delay is explicitly defining despite occasional HPO frequency. Eye and hearing damage are under 30%.
Intellectual disability defines the symptomatic syndrome; ureter abnormalities and hydronephrosis occur in 80-99%. Minor facial and digital morphology does not establish functional damage.
Hereditary structural abnormality of the external ear.
Benign ovarian stromal tumor without defining hormone dysfunction; reproductive tumor origin has no axis.
Isolated spermatogenic failure and male infertility; cryptorchidism is reproductive and no endocrine dysfunction is established.
Glioma originates along the optic nerve and central visual pathways. Optic atrophy and visual loss are common; endocrine and other CNS complications are occasional.
Inherited high myopia is ocular; an unspecified nervous system annotation does not establish common neurologic disease.
VPS35-associated Parkinson disease causes a degenerative neurologic movement disorder.
Progressive skeletal muscular dystrophy. Cardiomyopathy is annotated at 5-29%; speech delay alone does not establish direct CNS damage.
Primary skeletal myopathy; eyelid and ocular motor dysfunction are common: ptosis 10/10 and ophthalmoplegia 8/10. Dysphagia reflects muscle weakness.
